newsitem.title: CHINA: Lai Sun Dev considers US$150 mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun Dev considers US$150 mln bonds.

text.p: Lai Sun Development Co Ltd said on Wednesday it was considering an issue of up to US$150 million in guaranteed bonds due 2002 that would be convertible into company shares.
Lai Sun Development said the bond issue was subject to approval by shareholders at a general meeting.
The bonds would be issued by its wholly-owned Lai Sun International Finance (1997) Ltd.
Jardine Fleming International Inc has been appointed to lead manage the proposed issue, which would be offered to independent professional investors, it said.
The company said an application would be made to list the bonds in Luxembourg and that net proceeds would be used for repayment of debt and general working capital.
A statement would be made on finalisation of the terms and structure of the issue, including the principal amount, interest rate and the number of shares to be convertible, it said.
